Its apparent opulence is rivaled only by its combat capabilities.|Inventory|TotK}} Radiant Shields go unnamed in {{AoC}}. ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 35 |durability = 26 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Radiant Shield}} Radiant Shields are mid-grade [[Shield]]s made by the [[Gerudo]]. They are presented to [[Gerudo Soldier]]s once they achieve the rank of captain, and they are considered to be a direct upgrade to [[Gerudo Shield]]s. This is seen with [[Teake]], the captain of the Gerudo guard, who carries one on her back. In addition, they are also known for their incredible [[Shield Surfing]] abilities.{{Fact|BotW}} Their opulence is rivaled only by their capabilities in combat. They belong to the [[Gerudo Gear]] equipment archetype, a series of [[Weapon]]s created and utilized by the Gerudo.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 172}} There are four Radiant Shields scattered throughout [[Hyrule]], with a fifth added in [[Master Mode]].{{Where}} One can be found inside the secret cave in the mountain east of the [[Sho Dantu Shrine]], along with other pieces of Gerudo Gear. When scanned with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]], the following [[amiibo]] have a chance to spawn a Treasure Chest containing a Radiant Shield: * {{BotW}} Series [[Princess Zelda|Zelda]] amiibo * {{BotW|-}} Series [[Urbosa]] amiibo [[Selmie]] will comment on Radiant Shields if [[Link]] speaks to her with one equipped. She reveals that they are very rare, and she practically never sees them anymore.{{Cite|That's a radiant shield! You wouldn't believe how rare those things are! You practically never see them anymore...|Selmie|BotW}} Unlike other shields, the Radiant Shield can Shield Surf on stone. Due to their metal compositions, Radiant Shields will conduct [[Electricity]] and attract [[Lightning]] if they are equipped during [[Thunderstorm]]s. They also sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. However, they can be manipulated with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]], and they will not burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. {{BotW Shield Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Shield_036" |Life = 26 |GuardPower = 35 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 6 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMin = 4 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMax = 7 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 7 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 13 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMin = 8 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMax = 13 |RideBreakRatio = 0.6 |MirrorLevel = 0 |SurfingFriction = 0.1 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Radiant Shield}} {{Stub|TotK}} Radiant Shields reappear in {{TotK}}. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Radiant Shields can be wielded by [[Urbosa]] in conjunction with [[Moonlight Scimitar]]s. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Daybreaker * Gerudo Gear * Gerudo Shield * Shield }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Gerudo Gear, Shields |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
